newsitem.title: JAPAN: SS Pharm, Boehringer tie up to sell drugs in Japan.
newsitem.headline: SS Pharm, Boehringer tie up to sell drugs in Japan.

text.p: SS Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would tie up with German drug firm Boehringer Ingelheim International GmbH to launch two over-the-counter stomach medicines on the Japanese market in November.
Gastol, developed and produced by Boehringer, will be on the market from November, SS Pharmaceutical said in a statement. The drug is for treatment of stomach upsets.
Sales of the medicine are expected to be one billion yen in the initial year, it said.
Buscopan M, also for stomachache and other minor stomach complaints and based on Boehringer's Buscopan A, will also be launched in November, SS said.
Sales of Buscopan M are expected to be 200 million yen in the initial year, it said.
